items.criterion: Publishing a post stores one audio edition object in the bucket
items.judgment: Publish a post and confirm exactly one new object under the edition prefix

items.criterion: A gated edition is refused to a reader who has not paid
items.judgment: Request a gated edition as a free reader and confirm the server refuses it

items.criterion: Two simultaneous subscribes with one key create a single subscription
items.judgment: Fire two subscribes with one key and confirm one active subscription

items.criterion: A subscription charge books a balanced ledger transaction
items.judgment: Subscribe and confirm the transaction posts equal debits and credits

items.criterion: The ledger reconciles debits against credits
items.judgment: Read the ledger and confirm total debits equal total credits

items.criterion: A free-tier projection counts the whole audience and is sufficient
items.judgment: Read the projection at the free tier and confirm a sufficient reach

items.criterion: An entitled subscriber can play the gated edition
items.judgment: Play the gated edition as a premium subscriber and confirm it streams

items.criterion: Committing the gate writes the post paywall tier
items.judgment: Commit a gate and confirm the tier is persisted on the post

items.criterion: The audience field renders on its own dark plane distinct from the console
items.judgment: A person compares the field plane against the console surfaces

items.criterion: The field shows the projected reach and revenue before the gate is committed
items.judgment: A person watches the projection settle before the commit
